additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417636-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/S9 313882469001] internal issue CRM:02679000071
additional_info.body:
Dear Lara Anna Oblak,
I hope this message finds you well.
We have completed the analysis of the logs for the time you mentioned and found the following details regarding the charging session:
The error that occurred appears as a fault, but the charging session was failed in the authentication.
This was the first attempt, and upon reviewing the logs, we see that the session began with a "Session Start" and the EV was connected (A -> B2). However, no EV details were provided at this stage.
The charger then proceeded to request Authentication, but this was not provided, resulting in the charging session failing and triggering the "InternalError" code.
This issue was momentary, as the session recovered shortly after. As seen in the logs (B2 -> E), the charger moved from an error state to available shortly after (E -> A).
To clarify, the sequence suggests that authentication was completed after the vehicle was plugged in. We can confirm that the charging session proceeded as intended from the point of authentication (P01_Authentication -> P02_ParameterDiscovery). As such, the charging session worked as expected after this phase, which rules out the possibility of an issue with the vehicle.
Please let us know if you need any further details or assistance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
